segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the patches pull visible sebum and gunk from the nose and reduce pore size, with one long-time oily-skin sufferer describing pores staying smaller for the first time after regular use.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with 'super sensitive' skin reports no irritation from the patches, though other reviewers not specifying skin type describe burning, itching, or irritation around the nose, cheeks, and eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s report reduced pore visibility and improved texture with regular use, describing it as an improvement they had not achieved with prior routines.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report the patches pull visible 'gunk,' oil, and sebaceous filaments from clogged pores; several note this reduces pore appearance overnight, while a few report the strip removed nothing from their pores at all.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced or disappearing blackheads over repeated use, and some see improvement in existing acne near the nose; however, multiple reviewers state blackheads specifically did not budge despite gunk removal, and one reviewer's blackheads stayed exactly the same size.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the patch turning white/saturated with oil after overnight wear and report a mattifying, less-shiny nose the next day; one reviewer with an oily T-zone reports the effect fades within about 24 hours before pores refill.
concerns.redness: One reviewer mentions using the product on someone else's nose redness as a secondary benefit, but this is not a focus of most reviews.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report the patch feels moisturizing and leaves skin soft rather than dried out, though one reviewer notes it dried her skin slightly the day after use.
concerns.aging: One mature reviewer (40s) reports improved texture and fine-line appearance with repeated use alongside other products, describing it as a turning point after decades of trying other treatments.

aspects.libelle: Gentle overnight wear, no pain removing

extraits.titre: The patches work and made my pores look smaller
extraits.texte: Ive used small pimple patches before, but never a large nose patch like this one. Its a little difficult to apply the patch at first so i would reccomend centering the patch on the bridge of your nose then applying to the left side of your nose then the right side. I have oily skin so a lot of sebum was pulled overnight and my pores looked smaller. My skin was a little sticky but I washed this off easily in the morning with a light cleanser.
These are wonderful at removing sebaceous filaments from my nose. I have super sensitive, but this didn't bother my skin at all. I use these twice a week! They help with pesky pimples too.

Have wrestled with oily skin (especially back T zone) and large pores/sebaceous filaments since pretty much puberty hit, up til today in my early 40s. Have used everything under the sun to help, nothing delivering on lofty promises, and was finally at a routine that I was satisfied enough would keep my skin healthy and not make things worse, but still had to settle for blurring, blotting midday oil, and hiding my pores daily as age added insult to injury with the beginnings of fine lines and worsening texture. I swear, saw an improvement first use, though the pores appeared to fill back in and regain prominence after about 24 hours. After two uses of these strips my pores are looking AND STAYING better and less visible WITHOUT MAKEUP. A miracle I had given up hope for!! Treatment three, I'm ready to cry for joy, I didn't think it was possible. I love these and I think with semi regular use, along with the snail moisturizer I was able to trial run with the complimentary sample, I can keep my skin looking more clear, smooth, and fresh than it has in almost two decades. THANK YOU, I'm hooked.
I used this product on both myself (42) and also my 12 year old daughter. Absorbs oil and impurities so well and no pain whatsoever with removal. We will definitely keep using this product
it literally burned the skin of my nose and didn't even get out my pores 😭😭

extraits.titre: Works well, not really for blackheads
extraits.texte: I bought this thinking it would be like the Biore nose strips. I used up all the strips and it works well at pulling gunk out and smoothjng pores but does absolutely nothing for my blackheads (which is the main reason I bought it). Although it's nice that pulling it off jt not nearly as harsh as Biore, I will probably switch back to them to remove blackheads and have these on hand for the pore smoothness.

I'm an enormous fan of these and I use them on my nose, forehead, and cheeks. For years, I've had extremely stubborn blackheads on my nose and forehead and enlarged pores on my cheeks. These are one of the only products I've used that have actually helped to shrink my blackheads (and some have disappeared completely) and absorb gunk from the pores on my cheeks so those have shrunk too.
